name: Ignacy
source:
"Not just your face, but your heart is beautiful too. I didn't think I could meet a girl like you in this town."

An instructor that swore loyalty to the prince of the Alus Kingdom.
He's wandering from place to place searching for the prince who has gone missing.
A playboy who loves beautiful women and who can't resist flirting when he sees one.
